analysis:
This batch is documentation only: changelog.d/provider-addon-hold.md, docs/architecture/addon-hold.md, the README index, a model-autopilot.md busy-reason note (head 182-184) and test docs (test.md head 767-790). No Swift source is in this batch.

The docs describe a new local attack surface that the threat model does not yet cover. It is an owner-only AF_UNIX socket at ~/.darkbloom/runtime/addon.sock. A peer that passes AddonPeerPolicy (add-on code requirement, hardened runtime, same uid, identifier equal to the verified signer; addon-hold.md 78-82) can close admission, unload all models and keep the provider in draining. Holds persist across restarts (addon-hold.md 73-77). They also last indefinitely while ownership.lock is held (addon-hold.md 70-72, 89).

Impact is availability only (TB-003 operator vs process). A local operator can already stop the provider, so no confidentiality, attestation or billing regression is evident. Holds keep the coordinator connection and App Attest worker alive (addon-hold.md 14, 62-63). The coordinator must not treat a held provider as serving; this relies on the existing draining status (README/changelog line 16-17). Busy fields busy_reason, busy_since_ms and busy_addon are new wire fields in heartbeat/register. The coordinator side is platform-owned and not verified here.

The threat model needs a new boundary or threat entry covering:
- the add-on IPC peer and the persisted hold record;
- interaction with T-053/TB-011, since grants are retained while models are unloaded;
- busy_addon as a new heartbeat identifier, relevant to T-058 linkage.

The integration pass must verify these in source:
- AddonPeerPolicy.swift: real code-signing checks, with no test-authenticator bypass in production builds. test.md says the peer check is tested only negatively.
- AddonIPCServer.swift: socket mode/ownership, line-length bound and stale-socket handling.
- AddonHoldStore.swift: owner-only writes and no symlink following in the runtime dir.
- ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift: the 120 s drain still fails closed. Cancelled work must emit typed terminals, not plaintext (T-008).
- Release path: correct reopening, and rebuilt capacity must not admit before a pending reconnect registers.
- ProviderBusy.swift: field bounds and validation.
